worldcombat.skill.ragefist.summary: Bank every blow you take as a fist mark, then throw them all back at once: each hit you take adds a mark, and every mark becomes another ghostly punch. The marks stay through the fight, so the way to use it is to take hits first, then let the flurry out.
worldcombat.skill.ragefist.use.0: Take a few hits to bank marks, then spend the flurry
worldcombat.skill.ragefist.use.1: Grow the punch count through a close brawl
worldcombat.skill.ragefist.use.2: Throw flurries again and again on the frenzy form's shorter cooldown
worldcombat.skill.ragefist.description.0: Each ghostly punch deals about %1$s contact damage; every fist mark you carry adds one more punch, currently %2$s marks.
worldcombat.skill.ragefist.description.1: The pass throws %1$s punches, %2$s ticks apart, each dealing its own damage.
worldcombat.skill.ragefist.description.2: Each punch reaches %1$s blocks with a %2$s block hit radius and shoves the target %3$s blocks; every hit you take refreshes the marks to %4$s.
worldcombat.skill.ragefist.description.3: Each time another source actually damages you (status moves do not count) you bank one fist mark, up to %1$s in a fight; past the cap only the timer refreshes. Throwing the flurry does not spend the marks - they scatter only after their duration runs out without further hits.
worldcombat.skill.ragefist.fury.on: Frenzy form: the mark cap drops to 4 (up to 5 punches), but the punch interval is -1, preparation -1 and cooldown -5 - a snappy flurry for fragile targets.
worldcombat.skill.ragefist.fury.off: Grudge form: the mark cap is 6 (up to 7 punches) on the standard rhythm - slower, but a higher ceiling in a long brawl, made for tanky targets.
worldcombat.skill.ragefist.timing: Range %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s committed cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.ragefist.growth.0: From level %1$s: each punch %2$s, marks last %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.ragefist.growth.1: From level %1$s: each punch %2$s, marks last %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.ragefist.preference.fu: On (frenzy): the mark cap drops to 4 (up to 5 punches), but the punch interval is -1, preparation -1 and cooldown -5 - a snappy flurry for fragile targets. Off (grudge): the mark cap is 6 (up to 7 punches) on the standard rhythm - slower, but a higher ceiling in a long brawl, made for tanky targets. Cap against rhythm, each direction with its own opening.
worldcombat.skill.ragefist.preference.ai: Within this distance it is willing to open the flurry; beyond it the priority drops low (the shared approach still walks it in, and it returns after being knocked back). It is a string of close punches, so a larger value only starts it a little sooner.
On: each banked fist mark raises the priority further - being hit is exactly when this punch is heaviest. Off: ignore the marks and rank it as an ordinary close-range attack.
